films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Perseus opens with Danae's chest and the Seriphos court — the bronze tower and golden shower retold as stop-motion myth.

popCulture.title: Danaë
popCulture.description: The princess shut in bronze, visited by Zeus as gold, cast to sea with her infant — Seriphos begins where Acrisius' fear ends.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The chest-born hero reared by Dictys on Seriphos — Athena's favorite whose birth already holds the oracle that will kill Acrisius.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid retells the shower of gold and the floating chest — Danae and Perseus as metamorphosis before the Gorgon's head.
